claim.statement: Current OpenCode agent documentation describes Build as the default primary agent with all tools enabled and Plan as a restricted primary agent in which file edits and bash commands require approval; it also distinguishes primary agents from manually or automatically invoked subagents.

source.title: OpenCode Agents
source.locator: Primary agents; Build; Plan; Subagents; permissions

lifecycle.reason: Rolling publisher documentation that may postdate v1.18.16.

limitations: The current page is not exact-version evidence for v1.18.16 and does not establish which agent or custom configuration applies to a session.
unknowns: The current documentation revision, selected primary agent, subagent path and effective permission policy are unknown for any use.

relationships.note: Rolling-current documentation and exact v1.18.16 source have different version/time applicability; the documented current Plan restrictions are not silently treated as v1.18.16 behavior.
